Question: Using NHANES from 2009 to 2016 we will run a logistic regression where the predictor is neutrophil count / lymphocyte count, categorize in quartiles (%) Q1: ≤25, Q2: >25 and ≤50, Q3: >50 and ≤75, Q4: >75 and adjust for age, sex, race. Outcome is depression which is based on the total score from the nine questions "have little interest in doing things", "feeling down, depressed, or hopeless", "trouble sleeping or sleeping too much", "feeling tired or having little energy", "poor appetite or overeating", "feeling bad about yourself", "trouble concentrating on things", "moving or speaking slowly or too fast", "thought you would be better off dead", calculated where each question has value of Not at all (0), Several days (1), More than half the days (2), Nearly every day (3), if value is null assign (0), and the total score >=10 was defined as clinically relevant depression and else was not. We will include participants who are equal or more than 18 years and diabetic patients where diabetes is defined as diabetes history or subjects taking antidiabetic medications or insulin now. We will exclude participants who had missing data on depression questionnaires, diabetes questionnaire, and NLR that requires neutrophil count and lymphocyte count.
Structured Question:
Analysis Type: logistic regression

Dataset: NHANES

Period of Interest: 2009-2016

Inclusion Criteria:
- age >= 18
- (diabetes history = Yes OR antidiabetic medications = Yes OR insulin = Yes)

Exclusion Criteria:
- missing 'have little interest in doing things' OR missing 'feeling down, depressed, or hopeless' OR missing 'trouble sleeping or sleeping too much' OR missing 'feeling tired or having little energy' OR missing 'poor appetite or overeating' OR missing 'feeling bad about yourself' OR missing 'trouble concentrating on things' OR missing 'moving or speaking slowly or too fast' OR missing 'thought you would be better off dead'
- missing diabetes history OR missing antidiabetic medications OR missing insulin
- missing neutrophil count OR missing lymphocyte count

Covariates:
- age
- sex
- race

Predictor:
- neutrophil count / lymphocyte count categorized into quartiles:
  Q1: ≤25th percentile
  Q2: >25th percentile and ≤50th percentile
  Q3: >50th percentile and ≤75th percentile
  Q4: >75th percentile

Outcome:
- depression = 1 if Total Depression Score >= 10; 0 otherwise
  Total Depression Score calculated as the sum of scores from the following nine questions:
  - 'have little interest in doing things'
  - 'feeling down, depressed, or hopeless'
  - 'trouble sleeping or sleeping too much'
  - 'feeling tired or having little energy'
  - 'poor appetite or overeating'
  - 'feeling bad about yourself'
  - 'trouble concentrating on things'
  - 'moving or speaking slowly or too fast'
  - 'thought you would be better off dead'
  Each question's score is assigned as:
    Not at all: 0
    Several days: 1
    More than half the days: 2
    Nearly every day: 3
  If a question's value is null, assign 0.

-- ========== STEP 1: Inclusion ==========

-- STEP 1.1: Includes all patients aged 18 or older
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_inclusion_age AS
SELECT "respondent_sequence_number"
FROM final_master_table
WHERE "age_in_years_at_screening" >= 18;

-- STEP 1.2: Identify diabetic patients based on history, medication, or insulin use
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_inclusion_diabetes_status_raw AS
SELECT
    f."respondent_sequence_number",
    (
        f."doctor_told_you_have_diabetes" = 'Yes' OR
        f."take_diabetic_pills_to_lower_blood_sugar" = 'Yes' OR
        f."insulin_uu_ml" IS NOT NULL -- Interpreting "insulin = Yes" as insulin_uu_ml is not null
    ) AS is_diabetic
FROM final_master_table f
JOIN temp_inclusion_age i ON f."respondent_sequence_number" = i."respondent_sequence_number";

-- STEP 1.3: From the above group, include only those who are diabetic
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_inclusion AS
SELECT "respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_inclusion_diabetes_status_raw
WHERE is_diabetic = TRUE;

-- ========== STEP 2: Exclusions ==========

-- STEP 2.1: Exclude patients with missing data on any of the nine depression questionnaires
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_missing_depression_q AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_inclusion i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE
    f."have_little_interest_in_doing_things" IS NOT NULL AND
    f."feeling_down_depressed_or_hopeless" IS NOT NULL AND
    f."trouble_sleeping_or_sleeping_too_much" IS NOT NULL AND
    f."feeling_tired_or_having_little_energy" IS NOT NULL AND
    f."poor_appetite_or_overeating" IS NOT NULL AND
    f."feeling_bad_about_yourself" IS NOT NULL AND

CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_missing_diabetes_info AS

-- 4.4 Neutrophil Lymphocyte Ratio (NLR)
-- Calculate raw NLR for cohort
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_nlr_raw AS
SELECT
    c."respondent_sequence_number",
    (f."segmented_neutrophils_num_1000_cell_ul" / f."lymphocyte_number_1000_cells_ul") AS "neutrophil_lymphocyte_ratio_value"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- Compute quartile cutoffs for NLR within cohort
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_nlr_cutoffs AS
SELECT
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "neutrophil_lymphocyte_ratio_value") AS q1,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "neutrophil_lymphocyte_ratio_value") AS q2,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "neutrophil_lymphocyte_ratio_value") AS q3
FROM temp_nlr_raw;

-- Assign NLR quartile group
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_neutrophil_lymphocyte_ratio AS
SELECT
    n."respondent_sequence_number",
    CASE
        WHEN n."neutrophil_lymphocyte_ratio_value" IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN n."neutrophil_lymphocyte_ratio_value" <= (SELECT q1 FROM temp_nlr_cutoffs) THEN 'Q1: ≤25th percentile'
        WHEN n."neutrophil_lymphocyte_ratio_value" <= (SELECT q2 FROM temp_nlr_cutoffs) THEN 'Q2: >25th percentile and ≤50th percentile'
        WHEN n."neutrophil_lymphocyte_ratio_value" <= (SELECT q3 FROM temp_nlr_cutoffs) THEN 'Q3: >50th percentile and ≤75th percentile'
        ELSE 'Q4: >75th percentile'
    END AS "neutrophil_lymphocyte_ratio"
FROM temp_nlr_raw n;

-- 4.5 Depression
-- Calculate individual scores for each of the nine depression questions
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_depression_individual_scores AS
SELECT
    c."respondent_sequence_number",
    COALESCE(CASE f."have_little_interest_in_doing_things"
        WHEN 'Not at all' THEN 0
        WHEN 'Several days' THEN 1
        WHEN 'More than half the days' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Nearly every day' THEN 3
        ELSE 0 -- Handles values not matching categories, including NULLs if not explicitly handled by COALESCE
    END, 0) AS score_q1,
    COALESCE(CASE f."feeling_down_depressed_or_hopeless"
        WHEN 'Not at all' THEN 0
        WHEN 'Several days' THEN 1
        WHEN 'More than half the days' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Nearly every day' THEN 3
        ELSE 0
    END, 0) AS score_q2,
    COALESCE(CASE f."trouble_sleeping_or_sleeping_too_much"
        WHEN 'Not at all' THEN 0
        WHEN 'Several days' THEN 1
        WHEN 'More than half the days' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Nearly every day' THEN 3
        ELSE 0
    END, 0) AS score_q3,
    COALESCE(CASE f."feeling_tired_or_having_little_energy"
        WHEN 'Not at all' THEN 0
        WHEN 'Several days' THEN 1
        WHEN 'More than half the days' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Nearly every day' THEN 3
        ELSE 0
    END, 0) AS score_q4,
    COALESCE(CASE f."poor_appetite_or_overeating"
        WHEN 'Not at all' THEN 0
        WHEN 'Several days' THEN 1
        WHEN 'More than half the days' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Nearly every day' THEN 3
        ELSE 0
    END, 0) AS score_q5,

        WHEN 'Several days' THEN 1
        WHEN 'More than half the days' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Nearly every day' THEN 3
        ELSE 0
    END, 0) AS score_q6,
    COALESCE(CASE f."trouble_concentrating_on_things"
        WHEN 'Not at all' THEN 0
        WHEN 'Several days' THEN 1
        WHEN 'More than half the days' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Nearly every day' THEN 3
        ELSE 0
    END, 0) AS score_q7,
    COALESCE(CASE f."moving_or_speaking_slowly_or_too_fast"
        WHEN 'Not at all' THEN 0
        WHEN 'Several days' THEN 1
        WHEN 'More than half the days' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Nearly every day' THEN 3
        ELSE 0
    END, 0) AS score_q8,
    COALESCE(CASE f."thought_you_would_be_better_off_dead"
        WHEN 'Not at all' THEN 0
        WHEN 'Several days' THEN 1
        WHEN 'More than half the days' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Nearly every day' THEN 3
        ELSE 0
    END, 0) AS score_q9
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- Calculate total depression score
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_total_depression_score AS
SELECT
    "respondent_sequence_number",
    (score_q1 + score_q2 + score_q3 + score_q4 + score_q5 + score_q6 + score_q7 + score_q8 + score_q9) AS "total_depression_score"
FROM temp_depression_individual_scores;

-- Determine depression outcome (1 if total score >= 10, else 0)
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_depression AS
SELECT
    "respondent_sequence_number",
    CASE
        WHEN "total_depression_score" >= 10 THEN '1'
        ELSE '0'
    END AS "depression"
FROM temp_total_depression_score;
